item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tactical BDU Shorts are just what you need for the trail, range, and casual style. The cargo shorts provide with 6 pockets for plenty of EDC (Everyday Carry) storage options; two front slash pockets and two rear button down pockets, plus two large side cargo pockets. The adjustable waist tabs offer a perfect belt-free fit, while the tactical shorts also offer belt loops for accessorizing. Whether you’re on a high-stakes mission or just hanging out with friends, Rothco has got you covered with our Tactical BDU Shorts.
